newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Nan Ya 1996 pretax profit down 5.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Nan Ya 1996 pretax profit down 5.7 pct.

text.p: NOTE - Nan Ya Plastics Corp is Taiwan's largest private industrial enterprise and a key member of the Formosa Plastics group.
Nan Ya's board on Tuesday proposed a 1997 dividend of T$2.2 per share, comprising T$1.1 per share in cash dividend and T$1.1 per share in stock dividend, or bonus issue, the firm said.
The company set a 1997 pretax profit target of T$9.048 billion, up 7.7 percent from 1996, and a 1997 sales target of T$94.921 billion, up 6.8 percent from year ago, Nan Ya said in a statement.

Nan Ya plans to issue T$6 billion in corporate bonds to raise long-term funds for operations, but gave no issue date. The term will be less than seven years and the coupon rate lower than 7.0 percent in principle, it said.
Nan Ya plans to invest T$5.165 billion to expand its production of partially oriented yarn and polyester drawn texturised yarn, it said.
The expansion, once construction is completed in December 1999, will add T$4.805 billion in annual sales, Nan Ya said.
All of the proposals need final shareholder approval at a meeting slated for May 20, it said.
